description: Deep dive checklist for filling real program info, fees, and requirements for all 96 Malaysian universities

universities.name: Asia e University
universities.notes: All 30 programs verified from official website (2026-09-18). Duration, mode, intakes, entry requirements, MQA codes confirmed. Fees not publicly available - university requires direct contact. Brochure PDFs checked, no fee data.

universities.name: AIMST University
universities.notes: 48 programs total (info.json was wrong at 39). 7 programs fully verified with MQA codes, real requirements, and durations from aimst.edu.my. Remaining 41 programs updated with medium confidence. Fees not published - contact university. Checked 2026-09-18.

universities.name: Albukhary International University
universities.notes: 14 UG + 7 PG programs. All UG fully scholarship-funded (Albukhary Foundation). Single October intake (not 3x/year). Real postgraduate fees: Masters RM8,150-31,950, PhD RM19,150-23,750. All MQA codes verified. PhD requirements fixed (was incorrectly Bachelor's). Checked 2026-09-18.

universities.name: Asia Metropolitan University
universities.notes: 22 programs (16 active + 5 ODL Coming Soon + 1 empty cert). All MQA codes verified. Real international fees from official source. Several duration corrections (Accountancy 4yr, Healthcare 4yr, diplomas 2-2.5yr). Master intakes 5x/year. Checked 2026-09-18.

universities.name: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation
universities.notes: 113 programs across 6 levels. Real international fees from official APU course pages (RM21,200-RM137,200). Malaysian fees also available on course pages (RM19,500+). Per-programme year-by-year breakdowns on individual course pages. Detailed entry requirements. 0.9 confidence. QS World Top 2%. Checked 2026-09-18.

universities.name: Berjaya University College
universities.notes: 24 programs across 4 faculties. MQA codes verified for 17/24 programs. All diploma durations corrected from 3yr to 2yr. MBA corrected to 1yr FT. Fees not published - contact university. Checked 2026-09-18.
